purpose: Evidence that 5 new very_hard Splunk tasks were created and validated
design_principle: All verifiers find ANY new artifact with correct properties, not specific named ones. PASS_THRESHOLD=80 requires 4 of 5 criteria.

tasks.description_excerpt: Investigate authentication event data... build automated detection infrastructure that will continuously monitor for and alert on this type of compromise activity

verification.partial_description: Search refs security_logs + detects both states but not scheduled = 60, does NOT pass (threshold=80)
verification.wrong_target_description: Scheduled alert on web_logs (not security_logs) = 60, does NOT pass
criteria: (1) At least one new saved search/alert created [20pts]
(2) Best new search references security_logs index [20pts]
(3) Best new search detects both failed AND successful auth events [20pts]
(4) Best new search is scheduled for continuous monitoring [20pts]
(5) Best new search has a cron expression configured [20pts]

tasks.description_excerpt: Identify IPs appearing in both web and authentication attack activity... Build a saved report that surfaces common attacker IPs across log sources, and create a dashboard

verification.partial_description: Cross-index report only, no dashboard = 40, does NOT pass
criteria: (1) At least one new saved search/report created [20pts]
(2) Best new search is cross-index (queries both web_logs and security_logs) [20pts]
(3) At least one new dashboard was created [20pts]
(4) Best new dashboard has >=2 panels [20pts]
(5) Best new dashboard panel searches reference security/web log indexes [20pts]

tasks.description_excerpt: Investigate system log volume trends... build a scheduled monitoring report... and create a dashboard to visualize volume trends

verification.partial_description: Report refs system_logs but no time analysis = 40, does NOT pass
criteria: (1) At least one new saved search/report created [20pts]
(2) Best new search references system_logs index [20pts]
(3) Best new search uses temporal analysis (timechart, span=, bucket _time, etc.) [20pts]
(4) Best new search is scheduled for continuous monitoring [20pts]
(5) At least one new dashboard with >=2 panels created [20pts]

tasks.description_excerpt: Build a lookup table of privileged accounts... Save a report that joins this lookup with live authentication log data

verification.partial_description: Lookup file + rows + definition = 60 (3 criteria), does NOT pass (threshold=80)
criteria: (1) At least one new lookup file exists in Splunk [20pts]
(2) New lookup file has >=5 data rows [20pts]
(3) At least one new lookup definition is configured [20pts]
(4) At least one new saved search was created [20pts]
(5) New saved search references a lookup (lookup/inputlookup command) [20pts]

tasks.description_excerpt: Create a comprehensive executive dashboard for security monitoring... create a threshold-based alert for high-volume attack detection

verification.partial_description: Dashboard with 3+ panels ref security_logs = 60, does NOT pass (threshold=80, requires both dashboard AND alert)
criteria: (1) At least one new dashboard was created [20pts]
(2) Best dashboard has >=3 panels [20pts]
(3) Best dashboard panel searches reference security_logs index [20pts]
(4) At least one new scheduled alert was created [20pts]
(5) Best scheduled alert search contains a numeric threshold condition [20pts]
